$comment: MODE = dark. Neutrals only. This is Confetti's dark look and the fallback for any theme that doesn't bring its own — a cool blue-violet ramp (colors.midnight) on a near-black content ground, with a deeper step below it as the recessed mat, lavender-tinged white text, and the brand red left as the one warm thing on the page. Light mode is a clean luxury white; the two modes are deliberately different temperatures rather than one being a tinted copy of the other. How light `card` is drives almost everything else here: it is the lightest surface, so it sets the contrast floor, and the palest brand red is what caps it. Subtle accent tints deepen (X.700) so the light foreground reads on them; the hover shadow is a black-based one, since a light shadow on a dark surface reads as nothing. Emitted under [data-mode='dark'].

backdrop.comment: recessed mat — the deepest midnight, below page

fill-hover.comment: a clear step lighter than the resting fill

status.$comment: STATUS roles — see the note in modes/light.json. Only `text` moves between modes: the rich green FILL carries its white label at 5.34:1 on any page, but the same green AS TEXT drops to 2.43:1 on the card surface, so it lifts to green.400 here.

subtle.comment: the tint end goes deep in dark, like the accent tints

danger.$comment: Danger splits by role. As a FILL it is solid red carrying a white label — the state a destructive control lands in on hover, and what a destructive surface is painted with. As TEXT (and the resting outline of a danger button) it is the same red, lifted to the palest step in dark mode so it holds AA on every dark surface.

fill.comment: solid danger red, carrying a white label at 6.27:1 — the same in both modes; a fill does not need to move

text.comment: danger AS TEXT — the palest red, and the same lift brand-as-text takes. It has to be the palest one: red.300 fails on Confetti's `card` (3.50:1) and on Adventure's #35492f and Neon's #2e1650 too, so no theme on this mode can afford the more saturated step.

on-bold.comment: bold hues stay light in dark mode, so the deepest midnight reads on them

on-subtle.comment: subtle tints are deep in dark mode — needs the light foreground

lift.comment: a card's hover — the indigo glow, the same size and spread as light's halo

button-lift.comment: buttons cast no shadow on hover — nothing raises

float.comment: held at rest: a deep shadow plus the light top edge — no glow, which is reserved for a card's hover
